analysis.title: GS US TMT: .. today (SPCX, NFLX) ..
key_insights: Futures are bid with NDX +65 bps alongside global tech strength. KOSPI is +3% overnight, with Samsung and Hynix +6%. Better SpaceX earnings and commentary may set up a tradeable bounce and show investors that earnings can matter. Focus shifts to META, TTMI, LRCX and TXN in the coming days.

The NDX has stabilized this week, but semis (SOX) have barely outperformed despite last week's drawdowns. MU, NVDA, ANET and DELL types are up only 1-2% on the week. Risk appetite and conviction remain limited, and investors have lowered conviction on what a durable clearing event could be into year end. Franchise flows and investor conversations remain back-footed, which suppresses near-term appetite to re-gross into the same names.

SpaceX (SPCX) is up 8% and is seen as a litmus test today. It addressed the debates on compute pricing and capacity ambitions. Pre-market inbounds focus on confidence in the SPCX roadmap and on read-throughs to hyperscaler peers, as the base case for GW capacity moved higher after SpaceX raised expectations last night.

SpaceX management cited line of sight to 2.5-3GW of nameplate compute by YE26 and potential to bring an incremental 10GW online in 2027, with an upside case of more than 20GW by YE27. Investors had gone into the print debating where in the prior 5-10GW range by end of 2027 SpaceX could land.

Early SPCX investor focus: the right framework for Super Intelligence revenues in CY27 (GIR raised 2027 SI revenues by about 70% to about $153bn), pricing visibility and durability of compute returns, execution on Flight 15's goal of capturing booster and ship, and a possible Starlink mobility investor teach-in.

SpaceX said new compute at current pricing generates a payback of under one year. Comments on the call imply lower build costs and better monetization could cut payback to about 6 months in 2027. Management named power, cooling and electrical infrastructure as the primary bottlenecks.
GIR raised its CY27 SpaceX revenue estimates by 50% overnight, after a 55% raise in early August following the C2Q print.

Netflix (NFLX) is down 7%, about 50% below all-time highs and at new roughly 2-year lows pre-market. Investors are debating whether this is a bottom. The questions are whether the ad miss is a timing issue (third-party integration delays) or a growth issue, what the fix is for US and Canada engagement and how long it takes, whether normalized growth is low-double-digit or high-single-digit y/y, and what the right multiple is. The stock trades at 14x GIR's CY28 GAAP EPS estimate of about $4.50.

NFLX positives per GIR: Q3 revenue, operating income and GAAP EPS were above prior guidance and GS/Street estimates, with subscription revenue outperforming and churn consistent despite price increases. Management is positive on the 2027 content slate (Narnia, Bridgerton, Wednesday, NFL games, Women's World Cup in the US and Canada). Q3 buybacks were about $4.8bn versus $4.7bn in Q2, with about $22.3bn remaining on the authorization.

NFLX negatives per GIR: Q4 revenue, operating income and EPS guidance is below prior GS/Street expectations. The FY FCF guide was cut from $12.5bn to about $12bn because of a Q4'26 real estate transaction. The FY2026 advertising revenue guide of about $2.7bn is below the prior guide of about $3bn because of slower ad product rollout. Management acknowledged US engagement has room for improvement.
NFLX has de-rated as consensus EPS estimate revisions have stalled.

Top client inbounds: SpaceX feedback, SPHR +10% yesterday, the AI and semis mood, the CRM and Braze news, earnings set-ups in the AI supply chain (TXN, LRCX), SaaS (NOW, WDAY, ADBE up 5-6% this week) and memory sentiment.

Earnings tonight: CCI, IBM, LRCX, META, ROL, TSLA, TXN, United Rentals. NVDA hosts GTC Berlin with a Jensen Huang keynote at 5am ET. Other events: Money 20/20 USA, Cloudflare Connect 2026, HR Technology Conference.

NFLX FY2026 free cash flow guide cut from $12.5bn to about $12bn because of a real estate transaction expected in Q4'26. FY2026 advertising revenue guide is about $2.7bn versus prior guide of about $3bn.
NFLX Q3 buybacks were about $4.8bn versus $4.7bn in Q2, with about $22.3bn remaining on the authorization.
NFLX trades at 14x GIR's CY28 GAAP EPS estimate of about $4.50.

SPCX earnings call (reported overnight 10/20 after close): management guided to 2.5-3GW of nameplate compute by YE26 and a potential incremental 10GW in 2027, with upside to more than 20GW by YE27. New compute at current pricing generates a payback under one year. GIR raised CY27 Super Intelligence revenues about 70% to about $153bn and CY27 revenue estimates by 50%.
Earnings tonight 10/21: CCI, IBM, LRCX, META, ROL, TSLA, TXN, United Rentals.
risk_factors: SpaceX execution risk: management named power, cooling and electrical infrastructure as the primary bottlenecks.
Industry capacity risk if SPCX executes at the mid or upper end of its GW ambitions.
Durability of SpaceX compute pricing and returns is an open question.
NFLX: slower ad product rollout from third-party integration delays, US engagement weakness and stalled consensus EPS revisions.
Low investor conviction on what a durable clearing event would be into year end.
